identity.name: Food Key
identity.tagline: Unlock the Flavor. The Art of Delivery.
identity.mission: To transform food delivery from a utility into a curated culinary experience. We don't just deliver food; we deliver mood.
identity.archetype: Jewel & Luxury (Dark Mode) / Organic & Earthy (Light Mode)

headings.usage: Main headers, Hero sections, Restaurant names. Use tight tracking.

primary.name: Electric Amber
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, Highlights, Rating Stars. The 'Key' color.

secondary.name: Neon Mint
secondary.usage: Success states, Vegan/Healthy tags, Delivery active status.

glassmorphism.usage: Floating Navigation, Modal Overlays, Toast Notifications.

grid_system.marketing: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) - Mix of 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 cells for categories.
grid_system.listing: Masonry or Asymmetrical Grid for restaurant cards to break monotony.
grid_system.dashboard: High Density Grid (4 columns) for analytics.

spacing.scale: Tailwind default but doubled (p-8, p-12, p-16).
spacing.rule: Generous whitespace around food images to let them 'breathe'.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black font-bold rounded-full hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,180,0,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-white/10

cards.restaurant: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-card border border-border hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300
cards.food_item: flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 rounded-xl bg-surface hover:bg-surface/80 transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-surface/50 border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-xl h-12

navigation.position: Fixed bottom (mobile) or Sticky top (desktop) with glassmorphism.

animations.fade_in_up: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Theme Toggle' but default to Dark Mode for the 'Ultra Stylish' feel.
Use 'Syne' font for all headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
Implement the 'Bento Grid' for the food categories section on the home page.
Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. DO NOT use generic placeholders.
For the AI Chatbot, create a floating action button (FAB) that opens a glassmorphism chat window.
Mock the OTP login flow: Any 4-digit code works.
Use Browser Geolocation API for the 'Detect Location' feature.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.

universal_guidelines.design_philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
anti_patterns: No 'teal' or 'purple' as primary colors (unless specified).

code_style.components: Use Shadcn UI for logic, Custom Tailwind for layout.
code_style.exports: Named exports for components, Default exports for pages.
